description: This file defines a PHP class for interacting with SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise (Sybase ASE) databases, including methods for retrieving table, database, and column metadata, and handling specific database operations.

classes.name: ADODB_sybase_ase
classes.description: Class representing the SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise (Sybase ASE) driver, extending the generic ADODB_sybase class with specific methods and properties for ASE.

classes.name: adorecordset_sybase_ase
classes.description: Class extending ADORecordset_sybase for recordset operations specific to Sybase ASE.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieve list of table or view names from the database based on specified type.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Retrieve list of database names from the server.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieve metadata for columns of a specified table.

methods.name: getProcedureList
methods.description: Stub method that currently returns false; intended to list stored procedures.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Generate an error message if the sybase PHP extension is missing, otherwise call parent error message handler.
